system.description:
You have confidence in your ability to learn information that others consider secret, and in doing so, boost your confidence in other areas.

Prerequisite: Bothan

Effect: Whenever you successfully use the Learn Secret Information application of the Gather Information Skill, you gain 1 Force Point. You cannot gain more than 3 Force Points each level, and you cannot have more Force Points than you gained when you reached your current level.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
